name: zscene_test_projected_sphere_visible
description: zScene::TestProjectedSphereVisible projects a view-space sphere to span-occlusion columns and reports whether any sampled column remains visible.
known_limits: Binary Ninja keeps a limited reconstruction marker because x87 projection math and the single-point transform loop remain verbose in HLIL.
No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this scene visibility helper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zModel display/span-occlusion pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x476700 validates the matrix-stack camera transform, near-plane early-visible return, ProjectPointBatch call, projected radius calculation, clip-rectangle rejection, span candidate setup, top/bottom/mid column tests, 8-column stepping, and TestColumnVisibility calls.

The native projected-sphere smoke verifies near-plane visibility, small projected-radius rejection, offscreen clip rejection, visible empty-column behavior, fully occluded span rejection, and candidate-in-front visibility.
